title: Roving demo tour - expense clipboard
content:
Personal scratchpad for the small roving demo tour (week of Apr 7). Mostly expense capture, local vendor notes, and quick day-of checklists. Use this as a single-source for receipts and ad-hoc reimbursements; final cleanup goes into Ramp under Project = ROVING-TOUR.

=== Quick rules / expense reminders ===
- Always get a receipt (paper/photo) for any purchase > $5. If vendor provides only a handwritten slip, photo + write a 1-line note (vendor name, what).
- Card preference: company card (if available). If using personal card, record last 4 + tag "personal-reim" in Ramp.
- Meals: team meals must list attendees. Per-diem fallback if meal receipt missing.
- Taxi/ride apps: forward electronic receipt to events slack thread and keep screenshot.
- Local currency receipts: include conversion rate in Ramp (use Google rate at time of purchase).
- Submit receipts within 14 days when possible; must be submitted before 30 days for corporate accounting.

=== Per-diem & currency cheat sheet ===
- Default per-diem (emergency / missing receipt): 60 USD/day.
- Sample conversions (snapshot 2025-02): 1 USD ≈ 130 KES (Kenya), 1 USD ≈ 1.35 CAD, 1 USD ≈ 0.92 EUR.
- When splitting group cost: record payer, total, and who owes who in the note. Use group reimbursement ticket if > 3 people.

=== Day-of checklist (venue + staff) ===
- Printed name badges: 40 unit run (see vendor below).
- Badge lanyards: spare 20.
- Power: 2x 6-port power strips, 3x USB-C power banks (fully charged night before).
- Internet: backup MiFi SIM (purchased locally) + tethering plan.
- Cash float: 100 USD in small notes for snacks/quick reimbursements. Log cash spend immediately.
- Arrival window: vendor load-in 07:30–08:30. Ops lead (Evan) to confirm entry door code by 07:00.
- Contact on-site: venue ops — Amina (see contacts).

=== Vendor / local contacts (primary) ===
- RapidID Print & Supply (badges, small banners) — contact: Joseph Mwangi — +254 722 555 101 — joseph@rapidid.ke — turnaround: same day for badges, 24 hr for banners.
- CityDash Courier (same-day materials transfer) — Dispatch: +254 733 999 210 — citydash@cdelivery.co.ke — note: invoice via email, chargeable to Redwood PO 2025-ROVE-01.
- Nairobi MiFi (temporary SIM & MiFi rental) — sales@nairobi-mifi.com — pick-up at Westlands kiosk — recommend prepaid 20GB daypack.
- Local caterer (box lunches) — FreshBite Events — +254 700 111 222 — freshbite-events@example.org — need headcount by 48h prior.

=== Sample expense entries (copy to Ramp) ===
- 2025-04-07 | Badge print | RapidID | 3,400 KES | Card: company | Receipt: rapid-badges-0407.jpg | Notes: 40 badges + 20 spares.
- 2025-04-07 | MiFi rental | Nairobi MiFi | 2,500 KES | Personal card | Receipt: mifi-rental-0407.png | Tag: personal-reim.
- 2025-04-07 | Taxi (airport→venue) | Bolt | 1,200 KES | Card: EVAN-XXXX | Screenshot sent to #events-tour.

=== Shipping / kit notes (hardware demos) ===
- If shipping demo devices: include packed serial numbers + CN22 form when crossing borders. Keep packing list in S3 under s3://redwood-events/roving-tour/packing-list.csv and link in Ramp expense.
- For loaner laptops, ensure each unit has an asset tag sticker (sticker inventory: sticker-2025-03-21.jpg).

=== Escalations & unresolved items ===
- Missing receipt for caterer (FreshBite) — ask for duplicate invoice; if unavailable, complete per-diem/meal split form and file an Ops ticket (Jira OPS-4821).
- CityDash billed incorrect distance — keep photos of waybill and open a dispute within 7 days.

=== Rapid notes / to-dos ===
- [ ] Confirm RapidID badge artwork at least 72h pre-event. Joseph prefers PNG 300dpi, include white background.
- [ ] Book CityDash pickup slot (Evan) and confirm courier invoice email address.
- [ ] Buy spare HDMI adapters and USB-C hubs (Samira). Keep receipts.
- [ ] Add on-call phone number to calendar invites (Amina + Evan + Maya).

=== Misc / personal reminders ===
- Bring a roll of gaffer tape and sharpies (marker color: black + silver).
- Take a quick photo of any handwritten receipt and upload immediately to Ramp mobile app. Timestamp the photo filename (e.g., receipt-20250407-1512.jpg).
- Keep expense notes terse but explicit: who, what, why. Example note: 'Samira lunch — 1/3 split with Evan & Maya — client intro (Nairobi)'.

If anything missing, add below or ping in #events-tour. This doc will be the working log until final closeout (T+14 days after last event date).
